residual.hint: How likely and how serious you expect it to be once the treatment is done. Set both to see the expected score.
residual.notWorse: Treatment should not make the risk worse. Lower the expected likelihood or raise the current one.

map.label: Risk map
map.caption: Risks by likelihood and impact. Each cell with risks links to those risks.
map.cellLabel: {above, select, true {Above appetite} other {Within appetite}}: {count, plural, one {# risk} other {# risks}}, likelihood {likelihood}, impact {impact}
map.legendAbove: Above appetite: the score is higher than {threshold}, the most the organisation accepts.
map.legendWithin: Within appetite: the score is acceptable.
map.unscored: {count, plural, one {# risk is not scored yet} other {# risks are not scored yet}}
map.noExpectedYet: No risks have an expected score yet. A risk appears here once its expected score after treatment is entered.
map.noExpectedLink: {count, plural, one {Show the # risk} other {Show the # risks}}
map.unplaced: {count, plural, one {# risk has no expected score yet} other {# risks have no expected score yet}}
map.legendRegion: Shaded cells are above your appetite; the line marks where appetite ends.

journey.label: Where this risk is on its way to approval
journey.ruleReviewerMayApprove: The reviewer {name} or an approver can approve
journey.waiting: Waiting {unit, select, day {{count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}} hour {{count, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}} minute {{count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}} other {less than a minute}}

picture.title: Risk picture
picture.legendNote: Each group of bars is one week: risks reported, approved and marked as treated.
picture.tableCaption: Risks reported, approved and marked as treated per week

lifecycle.title: Review and closing
lifecycle.intro: An approved risk is looked at again from time to time. Say it has been dealt with, that it is still accurate, or look at it again.
lifecycle.openActions: Finish or cancel the open actions first

close_dialog.title: Mark this risk as treated
close_dialog.description: Say what was done. The risk stays on record and leaves the map unless you include treated risks.
close_dialog.label: What was done
close_dialog.done: The risk is marked as treated.

confirm_dialog.title: Confirm this risk is still accurate
confirm_dialog.description: The next review moves on. You can leave a note.
confirm_dialog.label: Note (optional)

reassess_dialog.title: Reassess this risk
reassess_dialog.description: The risk goes back to proposed so it can be assessed and approved again.
reassess_dialog.label: Why is it being reassessed?
reassess_dialog.done: The risk is open for reassessment.

errors.openTreatmentActions: There are still open actions. Finish or cancel them first.
errors.riskClosed: This risk is already marked as treated.
errors.invalidTransition: The risk can't be changed that way any more. Reload and try again.

plan.title: Treatment plan
plan.noPeople: You can't list people here, so actions can't be assigned.

form.title: Add an action
form.description: Something that has to be done to treat this risk. The person you choose gets it as a task.

doneDialog.title: Mark this action done
doneDialog.description: You can leave a note about what was done.
doneDialog.label: Note (optional)

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this action
cancelDialog.description: It will not count towards the plan.
cancelDialog.label: Why is it cancelled?

errors.taskNotAssignee: Only the person it is assigned to, or a reviewer, can do that.
errors.invalidTransition: This task isn't completed here. Evidence requests are done by uploading the file; reviews by confirming the review.
errors.dueDatePast: Choose today or a later date.
errors.riskClosed: This risk is already marked as treated, so actions can't be added.
errors.treatmentIsAccept: An accepted risk has no treatment plan.
errors.invalid: Something in the form isn't accepted. Check it and try again.
errors.notFound: This is no longer open to you.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't save that. Please try again in a moment.
